campaign.description: A casual merge-and-battle game: merge units on a grid, then send them to crush escalating enemy waves. Quick sessions, satisfying upgrades and power-ups.
campaign.audience: casual mobile and web players who enjoy merge, idle, and tower-defense games
campaign.placement: CrazyGames portal cover card competing in a dense grid of game thumbnails
campaign.rules: no false claims; no unverifiable superlatives like '#1' or 'best' or 'guaranteed'; family-safe; keep the playful on-brand tone

baseline.headline: (wordless cover)
baseline.note: Real CrazyGames data: 128,000 impressions at 0.5% CTR -> only a few hundred clicks. In-game it scores 9.0/10 with 7m23s avg playtime, so the creative, not the game, is the bottleneck.

humanRedesign.note: A manual cover redesign (added title, hook, and a clearer character/scene) took days of human iteration. AdLift does this loop autonomously.
